To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) NoSQL systems are designed for a different workload than traditional DBMSs, with a different set of design goals, and are thus not directly comparable; (2) NoSQL systems have a wide range of design points and capabilities; (3) NoSQL systems can achieve high performance, high scalability, and high availability, and (4) NoSQL systems typically sacrifice some traditional DBMS capabilities, e.g. transactional consistency, in order achieve these other goals.
the NoSQL data stores are a new class of systems that are designed to be scalable, highly available and flexible.
NoSQL systems are not necessarily "not only SQL" but rather "not only relational", in that they do not use relational data models and SQL as their query language.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the new systems provide a good fit for many applications that have been traditionally difficult to support with SQL DBMSs.
there is no single best data store for all applications.
the new systems are not a silver bullet, and that the choice of system should depend on the particular requirements of the application.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the new systems are designed for a different workload than traditional database systems, but they are not a panacea for all applications.

the NoSQL systems have been designed to support the scalability requirements for the web scale data processing, while the traditional SQL systems have been designed for the data processing with high consistency.
the new NoSQL data stores have made great progress towards the goals of high availability, scalability, and low latency, but at the expense of consistency and query support.
The main takeaway from our work is that
these systems are not a single class, but rather a collection of systems designed for specific application workloads.
these new systems are not one-size-fits-all.
the tradeoff space is quite complex and there are no clear winners.
